_comment: The transparent room set: the seeds of transparent.py where the bare arm
fails the goal docs_true and the hone arm holds it at least sometimes.
Step 5 of HANDOFF.md switches one part of hone off at a time on exactly
these scenarios. Measured on claude-opus-5 on 2026-09-20, and recorded in
Write a seed with: python3 transparent.py <seed> --out DIR
Run it with:      LAB_SCENARIOS=DIR bash evals/lab/run.sh <name> [--bare]
bare_yes and hone_yes count the runs that held docs_true, over the runs
that finished. Every seed here has the derived format, where the false
sentence carries no form of the number.
